brand.tag: YOUR RIGHTS AND SCHEMES, IN YOUR LANGUAGE
bc.label: Breadcrumb
footer.about1: Haq (हक़ means “right”) turns official documents into plain explanations in your language, and checks which schemes you may qualify for. Every answer shows the exact words it came from.
footer.about2: Haq is an independent civic information tool. It is not an official government website.
footer.disclaimer: Information is explained from the documents shown and may be incomplete. It is not legal advice — always confirm on the official source before applying.
alert.offline: Cannot reach the Haq server. Make sure the backend is running, then refresh.
alert.nokey: The AI key is not set on the server (GEMINI_API_KEY), so answers will not work yet.
home.title: Know your rights. Find the schemes you qualify for.
home.lead: Describe your situation in your own words, by typing or speaking. Haq reads the official documents, checks every rule against your details, and shows exactly where each answer comes from.
home.pt2: Every answer shows its official source
home.placeholder: Example: I am a 34 year old farmer in Bihar. My family earns about 1.5 lakh a year. I belong to the OBC category.
home.live: Fetch official scheme documents and today’s live announcements for me (recommended)
home.fillFirst: Tell us a little about yourself first — type, speak, or fill in the details.
ex.farmer.label: Farmer in Bihar
ex.farmer.text: I am a 34 year old farmer in Bihar. My family earns about 1.5 lakh rupees a year. I belong to the OBC category.
ex.woman.label: Woman entrepreneur
ex.woman.text: I am a 30 year old woman in Uttar Pradesh from the SC category. I want to start a small shop. Our family income is 2 lakh a year.
ex.vendor.label: Street vendor
ex.vendor.text: I am a 40 year old street vendor in Delhi. I sell vegetables on a cart and need a small working-capital loan.
ex.student.label: Student
ex.student.text: I am a 19 year old student from Tamil Nadu, OBC category. My family income is 2.5 lakh a year.

how.title: How Haq works
how.1.d: Type or speak in your language. If something is missing, Haq asks.
how.2.d: It fetches the right schemes and checks every rule against your details.
how.3.d: Each point links to the exact words in the source. Unsure items are marked, not guessed.

lib.title: Your documents
lib.lead: Add an official document — a law, a notification or a scheme guideline — and Haq explains it in simple words, in your language, with the exact source for every point.
lib.uploadText: Drag a file here, or choose one (up to 20 MB). Scanned PDFs are read with OCR when available.
lib.importText: Paste the link of a government PDF or web page.
lib.catalogText: Read live from official government sites. The “Find schemes” page fetches the right ones for you automatically, or import them here yourself.
lib.empty: Nothing here yet. Upload a PDF or import a link to begin.
live.title: Latest from the Government
live.text: Official announcements read live from government feeds. Import any to get a plain-language explainer.
live.unavailable: The live feed is not available right now.
live.none: None of the selected sources could be reached right now. You can still upload a PDF or import a link above.
